applicableDomain: External Partner API Key Governance, Tenant Rate Limiting & Signed Event Webhook Subscriptions
descriptionAndPurpose: Provisions scoped API keys for external pharmacy, diagnostic, payer, and HIE integrators, enforces Bucket4j tenant rate quotas, and delivers HMAC-signed canonical patient journey webhooks.
prerequisiteConditions: Tenant facility provisioned and webhook TLS endpoint validated.
safetyChecks: Zero hardcoded fallback webhook secrets; cryptographic HMAC signature required.
Strict facilityId scoping prevents cross-tenant webhook leakage.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: API tier quota governed by tenant subscription policy.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Revoked API keys immediately terminate access and pause outbound webhook subscriptions.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: @ClinicalAudit logs key issuance, rotation, revocation, and scoped partner API invocations.
completionCriteria: Partner credentials active and webhook events durably delivered or safely dead-lettered.
